items.title: 13.5 Kinetic theory aur statistical physics (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.5, kinetic theory and statistical physics (PDF 11-12); the energy-level figure is ours (Roman Urdu only).

blocks.text: Ab tak humne dekha ke kinetic theory of gases, molecules ki thermal (random) harkat maan kar, gas laws ki madad se ideal gas ka pressure nikalti hai. Jab molecules bohat zyada hon to hum statistical physics istemal karte hain, physics ki woh shakh jo probability (ihtimal, kisi baat ke hone ka chance) ki theory se kaam leti hai. Is ke mutabiq system ke atoms aur molecules alag alag speeds ki wajah se alag alag energy states (levels) E₁, E₂, E₃ waghaira mein ho sakte hain.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: 1860 mein James Clerk Maxwell (1831–1879) ne ek formula nikala jo thermal equilibrium (hararati tawazun) wale system mein molecules ki speeds ki taqseem (distribution) batata hai. Taqreeban 60 saal baad experiments ne Maxwell ki peshgoiyon ki tasdeeq ki.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab naam 'James Clark Maxwell' chhapti hai; sahi naam James Clerk Maxwell hai.

Boltzmann ne Boltzmann kinetic equation nikali jo bohat se molecules wali gases mein hone wale amal (dynamic processes) ko bayan karti hai. Boltzmann constant do levels mein atoms ki tadaad (population) se bhi juda hai:

N₁ neeche (kam energy) wale state ki aur N₂ oopar (zyada energy) wale state ki population hai, aur ΔE = E₂ – E₁ dono states ki energy ka farq hai. Kitab yeh bhi kehti hai ke number density (unit volume mein particles) pressure ke seedhe tanasub mein hai (P = N₀k_BT se). Is equation ko Boltzmann distribution law kehte hain; yeh bohat se molecules ki statistical mechanics mein bunyadi hai. Is ke mutabiq kisi energy state mein molecule milne ka chance energy ÷ k_BT barhne ke saath exponential tareeqe se ghatta hai; is liye neeche ke energy states mein oopar walon se zyada particles hote hain.

blocks.alt: Do khaane, har aik mein paanch barabar faasle wale energy levels E1 se E5. Kam darja hararat par 25 zarrat: E1 par 16, E2 par 6, E3 par 2, E4 par 1, E5 par 0. Zyada darja hararat par wahi 25 zarrat: E1 par 10, E2 par 6, E3 par 4, E4 par 3, E5 par 2.
blocks.caption: Energy levels mein zarrat ki Boltzmann taqseem (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono khaanon mein particles barabar, 25 hain: garam karne se particles barhte nahi, sirf oopar ke levels mein phail jate hain. Kam temperature par zyada tar particles sab se neeche E₁ par hain aur E₅ khali hai. Zyada temperature par k_BT bara hai, is liye Boltzmann factor e^(−ΔE/k_BT) bara hota hai aur oopar ke levels ki population barhti hai, lekin har oopar wala level phir bhi neeche wale se kam bhara hai.

Gas ke bartan mein ek molecule har second arbon (billions) takkarein karta hai. Har takkar us ki speed aur kinetic energy badal deti hai, lekin kinetic theory ka nateeja hai ke temperature T par average kinetic energy:
Yahan k_B asal mein 'ek molecule ke liye gas constant' hai (R ek mole ke liye, k_B = R/N_A ek molecule ke liye).

blocks.prompt: Do levels ka farq ΔE = k_BT hai. Neeche wale level ke muqable oopar wale level mein kitne particles hain?
blocks.explanation: N₂/N₁ = e^(−ΔE/k_BT) = e⁻¹ ≈ 0.37. Yani oopar wale level mein neeche wale ke taqreeban 37% particles hain.

items: Bohat se particles ke liye statistical physics (probability) istemal hoti hai.
Boltzmann distribution law: N₂/N₁ = e^(−ΔE/k_BT); neeche ke levels mein zyada particles.
E_av = (3/2)k_BT; k_B ek molecule ke liye gas constant hai.
